text:
harry (partnerships): LatticeLabs sent an onboarding bundle claiming 'open weights + commercial redistribution'. They included a contributors.csv and short license-summary but no signed release. Need quick triage for marketplace + HW bundling and whether we can do a co-announcement.

nadia (legal): Immediate asks: signed release (sigstore or GPG), commit hashes with signatures, contributor CLAs/DCO records, and a detailed license matrix (code, weights, datasets). If any dataset is CC-BY-SA, redistribution downloads may be blocked. Also need an export-control self-report listing contributor countries.

prov-bot: PROVENANCE_SCAN: no verified signatures found in artifacts. FLAG: provenance_missing (HIGH). Attach signed release to clear.

reza (product): From product: allow hosted API ASAP. Gate downloads and HW bundles behind legal/provenance clearance. Require quantized builds (int8/4bit), runtime compatibility notes, and benchmark numbers. Recommend canary at 5% traffic with telemetry. Example snippet: `deploy.canary(percent=5, telemetry=true, auto_revert_on=["takedown","legal_claim"])`.

talia (marketplace): Marketplace states: three SKU modes — hosted-only, partner-bundle (restricted), redistributable downloads. Until docs are provided mark as hosted-only and show badge: "Redistribution: Pending". If redistribution is permitted, we need explicit redistribution scope (downloads? partner resell? hw preload?) and exact attribution text for UI.

jen (hw-partner): For device bundling we need explicit binary redistribution rights covering authorized resellers, package signing, firmware compatibility note, vulnerability disclosure contact, and a short SOW for preloading. We'll also want a revenue-share memo if redistribution is allowed.

nadia (legal): Draft redistribution clause (very rough): `Provider grants Redwood a non-exclusive license to host the Model. Distribution of model binaries to third parties, resellers, or hardware partners requires Provider's prior written consent and an executed redistribution addendum. Provider warrants it has the right to grant such licenses and that the Model does not contain materials subject to incompatible ShareAlike obligations.`

harry (partnerships): Action items: (1) Harry to request sigstore/GPG-signed release, commit sigs, CLA/DCO proof, SBoM, dataset manifests, and export-origin statement from LatticeLabs (ETA 72h). (2) Nadia to post attestation template + redistribution addendum draft (ETA 48h). (3) Reza to prepare canary plan + telemetry hooks and quantized-build checklist. (4) Talia to stage listing flags + co-marketing gating rules. (5) Jen to draft HW-bundle checklist + draft SOW. Scheduling a 20-min sync with LatticeLabs + Legal tomorrow 10:30 PT.

prov-bot: REMINDER: attach signed release to marketplace ticket to clear provenance checks.

harry (partnerships): Quick note on announcements: no co-marketing or press until legal_clearance == true and export_check == pass. If they want a joint webinar, require 2-week lead and pre-approved script. Tagging @nadia @talia @jen — update this thread with links once docs are uploaded. :handshake:
